name: jashanpreet-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio site for Jashanpreet Singh

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.resume: "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=public/Jashanpreet_Singh_Resume.pdf "file://$PWD/resume/resume.html" && node -e "const b=require('fs').readFileSync('public/Jashanpreet_Singh_Resume.pdf');const n=(b.toString('latin1').match(/\\/Type\\s*\\/Page[^s]/g)||[]).length;if(n!==1){console.error('Resume is '+n+' pages - must be 1');process.exit(1)}console.log('Resume OK: 1 page')"
